products.name: Logitech MX Master 4
products.description: A flagship premium office mouse for creative work, programming, and multitasking. The 8000 DPI sensor, quiet clicks, haptic side panel, and fast MagSpeed scrolling help you work comfortably on large monitors and switch efficiently between applications.

products.name: Logitech MX Master 3S
products.description: A popular office mouse for users who work with multiple applications and computers. Quiet clicks, the MagSpeed scroll wheel, an ergonomic shape, and an 8000 DPI sensor make it suitable for spreadsheets, graphics, document editing, and everyday productivity.

products.name: Logitech MX Anywhere 3S
products.description: A compact premium mouse for hybrid work and travel. The 8000 DPI sensor works on many surfaces, while the fast scroll wheel and quiet buttons make it a good match for laptops, small desks, cafés, and mobile workstations.

products.name: Logitech Lift Vertical
products.description: A vertical ergonomic mouse for long hours of computer work. The 57-degree hand angle helps reduce wrist strain, while Bluetooth and Logi Bolt connectivity make it easy to keep your workspace clean and organized.

products.name: Logitech Signature M650
products.description: A universal office mouse for everyday productivity. SmartWheel automatically switches between precise and fast scrolling, while quiet clicks make it suitable for open-space offices, studying, and home office use.

products.name: Logitech G Pro X Superlight 2
products.description: An extremely lightweight wireless esports mouse for FPS players. The HERO 2 sensor with up to 44000 DPI, fast LIGHTSPEED reporting, and minimalist shape help maintain precision during flicks, tracking, and long ranked sessions.

images.altText: Logitech G Pro X Superlight 2 main view

products.name: Razer Viper V4 Pro
products.description: An ultralight symmetrical wireless mouse for demanding competitive players. The Focus Pro 45K sensor, weight of around 49 grams, and fast HyperSpeed connection create a setup focused on FPS games, battle royale titles, and aim training.

images.altText: Razer Viper V4 Pro main view

products.name: Razer DeathAdder V4 Pro
products.description: An ergonomic esports mouse with the classic DeathAdder profile. The Focus Pro 45K sensor, low weight, and comfortable palm support make it a good fit for palm and claw grip in fast FPS games.

images.altText: Razer DeathAdder V4 Pro main view

products.name: Logitech G502 X Plus
products.description: A feature-rich gaming mouse for players who like extra buttons, fast scrolling, and RGB lighting. The HERO 25K sensor, LIGHTSPEED wireless technology, and programmable controls make it suitable for MMO games, strategy games, and work after hours.

images.altText: Logitech G502 X Plus main view

products.name: Razer Basilisk V3 Pro 35K
products.description: An advanced ergonomic gaming mouse for users who want many buttons and deep customization. The Focus Pro 35K sensor, HyperSpeed wireless, Bluetooth, wired connectivity, and distinctive Basilisk shape make it suitable for both gaming and work.

images.altText: Razer Basilisk V3 Pro 35K main view
